title: Her bosom was as a bird’s, soft and slight, slight and soft as the breast of some dark-plumaged dove.
html_source: The constant metaphorical comparison that Joyce uses for how Stephen describes women is this novel can refer to nature. It shows that Joyce uses ecological description of women to explain their characteristics. It is common today still, such as “mother nature.” This could also be referencing that all Stephens feelings are of pure nature and suggest that his feelings match the way nature is interpreted; as mysterious, and enticing.
